source: release tekken-models-batch-3 / asset beast-king-tekken-revolution.zip (RoxasKennedy SFM port of Tekken Revolution Beast King), file 'Beast King by RoxasKennedy/generic_item.mesh.ascii'
engine_family: Tekken 6-era (Tekken 6 / Tekken Revolution / Tekken Tag Tournament 2 share this skeleton convention)
finger_naming: arm {left|right} finger {1..5}{a|b|c} — digits numbered 1-5, segments lettered a (proximal) -> c (distal)

finger_segments.note: right hand missing 'arm right finger 5c' in this particular port (2-segment pinky on right, 3-segment on left) — authoring asymmetry in the source port, not a Tekken convention

segment_lengths_m.note: 3D Euclidean distances between consecutive finger bone bind positions (meters); finger5 has only 2 segments in this port

fist_vs_open: no procedural system in the data; fists/open hands are authored animation poses on these chains
extraction_method: parsed generic_item.mesh.ascii bone table (name, parent index, bind position); bone indices verified against parent links
